lost_requests_root_causes: Communication Channel Fragmentation: Client edit instructions arrive across 4 unlinked channels (Email, WhatsApp DMs, Voice Notes, and Instagram DMs) with no centralized intake portal or ticketing system.

Untranscribed Audio Notes & Neglected Inboxes: Voice notes sent to WhatsApp are listened to informally on mobile but never transcribed into task cards; Instagram DMs are neglected by production staff.
Missing Centralized Board Ticketing: Client feedback remains isolated in personal staff phones rather than attached to video task cards ('notes_on_board') on the production board.

Editor Scaling & Onboarding Breakdown: Adding junior editor Sam in July 2026 ($22/hr) and freelance editor Dev in September 2026 ($40/hr) without standardized style guidelines triggered severe revision loops (Sam avg 0.81 rev, Dev avg 1.21 rev).

Absence of Internal QA Gate: Revised video edits are exported back to clients without verifying adjustments against the original request, causing clients to complain repeatedly about unaddressed issues.
